title: Specify the versioned dashboard intent, evidence and decision handoff
summary: Specify and freeze a bounded versioned contract from StateCivics-approved personal/client monitoring objectives and authorized evidence to Matter assessment and attention results. Reuse current records and ports; this ticket defines the shared boundary without building a second service or implying production/provider qualification.
in_scope: Proposed input/output groups, exact context/evidence/version/time bindings, compatibility and failure semantics.
Cross-side ownership and scope/default/replay/feedback decisions D1-D7 with StateCivics KS-1122/1123/1125/1126.
Synthetic positive/negative compatibility fixtures and acceptance handoff; a callable contract independent of deployment topology.
out_of_scope: Runtime adapter implementation (MAT-082), dashboard/API changes (StateCivics), schema migrations or provider execution in this contract ticket.
DIAT, custom alert writing, new storage/queues/clients, production alerts or certification.
Replacing MAT-048/049 full civic acceptance or assuming archived client notes authorize an intent.
implementation: Inspect actual WatchIntent/Revision and EvidencePacket/IntentAssessment, tracking schemas and owner-scoped service; name unchanged fields versus the broad record/topic/project scope extension owned by KS-1122. Client is optional; one client may have several independent objectives. Do not invent fake bill identities.

Turn docs/plans/dashboard-matter-handoff.md input/output groups into a reviewed versioned specification with exact types, limits, hashes, explicit unknowns, schema compatibility and idempotency/attempt identity. Define purpose, scope, changes of interest, provision positions/exclusions, responsibility/timing and preferences separately from source facts.

Specify host-authenticated workspace/account/client and exact active intent revision bindings; an allowlisted monitoring DTO excludes contacts and unrelated notes. Approval/activation provenance is host-owned; model text and submitted IDs never confer access.

Specify source-only authorized evidence manifests and client-independent finding digests, exact citation/derivation/coverage/occurrence scope, prior actually communicated content and outcome receipts, current MAT-072 access and provider limits. Do not hold database snapshots over provider I/O.

Specify attention treatment, structured reasons/citations/limitations, stale/error/denied/unknown results, permitted use, dependency/currentness guards and logical result/receipt keys. Preserve separate captured/delivered/consumed/acted outcomes and on-demand quiet inspection.

Specify one contract for replay/live: event/publication/effective/available times remain separate; explicit evidence cutoff and context-selection policy; real authorization/provider budget uses the host clock. Include a positive for a future hearing/deadline whose notice is already available.

Resolve D1-D7 jointly with named StateCivics owners before dependent code: broad scope, client-default inheritance, stance granularity, activation UX, replay context mode, baseline/feedback compatibility, cadence/privacy defaults. Record proposals as proposals until chosen; freeze synthetic compatibility examples and question/profile/qualification bindings.

Record local/external dependency gates: KS-1122 consumes this contract; MAT-082 and KS-1123 can proceed once it and host mapping are agreed; KS-1124 connects both; KS-1126 supplies the receiving capture receipt. Cross-repo readiness is not inferred from this repository graph.

Pinned host review at StateCivics e349713e6 plus record correction e2dcb04cc: main ownership checks and create/revise/retire exist; current MAT-072 host controls, draft/pause/revoke, broad create scope, record-free capture provisioning and live assessment configuration remain StateCivics work. Freeze the specification with these requirements explicit, without claiming them implemented.

acceptance.criterion: The shared contract maps existing host intent/evidence/result records and names each genuine missing field without introducing duplicate ownership.
acceptance.verification: Review a field-by-field mapping against pinned StateCivics code and MAT-018/019/023/028/072; retain decisions and explicit limits for personal/client and broad/record scopes.

acceptance.criterion: Draft, active revision, context edit, pause/revoke and current access semantics are explicit and cannot be granted by evidence or provider output.
acceptance.verification: Review sequence examples for draft autosave, explicit activation, edit/revoke while queued/in flight and current authorization during historical replay; every transition names the host control/guard and owner.

acceptance.criterion: Identical source findings can yield different authorized audience consequences with traceable baselines, citations and honest unknown/failure reasons.
acceptance.verification: Freeze paired synthetic requests/results with one shared source digest, different clients, an outcome-unknown prior send, expected silence, duplicate and correction. Keep expected judgments outside provider-visible fields.

acceptance.criterion: Replay/live availability and context choices are unambiguous and all pre-implementation design decisions have named dispositions.
acceptance.verification: Review late-arrival and already-published future-event positives, historical versus retrospective-context examples and D1-D7 records; reject unrecorded assumptions, raw private notes and future-available sources.

acceptance.criterion: StateCivics counterpart owners can implement against a pinned contract without treating this planning artifact as a shipped interface or qualified provider.
acceptance.verification: Record KS-1122/1123/1124/1125/1126/1127 mappings, version/compatibility fixtures and review receipt; completion requires the frozen specification, not new live calls or production deployment.

tests: Personal objective with no client and two objectives under one client.
Same-number cross-jurisdiction source identities and a broad scope with no record ID.
Provider packet excludes contact/notes canaries and other-client rationale.
Late source available after publication; future-event notice available before the event.
risks: Unreviewed field-group proposals can accidentally become executable defaults; freeze D1-D7 decisions before dependent code.
A host/domain DTO could contaminate the neutral common core; keep explicit adapter/profile ownership and host-authoritative permissions.

reuse.application: Use existing independent context versions, dispositions, attention baselines, source egress and durable receipts.
Map the actual existing owner-scoped revision store/API; KS-701 is in_review and its applicable acceptance must close rather than being reimplemented.

reuse.source: mfreeze77/state-civics-ai:KS-1122, KS-1123, KS-1124, KS-1125, KS-1126, KS-1127
reuse.application: Named external counterpart ownership/gates; draft contract precedes implementation, actual connected acceptance remains host-owned.
Reuse provider/suggestion ownership, existing client tools, no-login replay and public-source capture; preserve their distinct completion limits.
